name: Liljestrand House
funding: The Liljestrand Foundation owns and runs it on donations and public tour and program revenue, with no endowment. Partners: Kaimana Beach Hotel, Aesop, OX Social, Honolulu Beerworks and Paiko.

name: San Carlos Institute
funding: Florida non-profit run by a volunteer board that says donations and volunteers maintain the building. State of Florida grants of $2.8 million paid for the restoration reopened in 1992.

name: The Frank Lloyd Wright House in Ebsworth Park
funding: Not confirmed. Contributions were $570k of $794k revenue in 2024 and no donor list is published. Board chair Clare Davis and David Obedin match roof gifts up to $100k.

name: Frelinghuysen Morris House & Studio
funding: Endowment from Suzy Frelinghuysen's 1988 bequest, built partly by selling the couple's New York apartment and Paris townhouse. Dividends $649,240 and gains $566,931 of $1.28M revenue in 2023.

name: Hollyhock House
funding: The City of Los Angeles owns it and its Department of Cultural Affairs runs it on the city budget. The Barnsdall Art Park Foundation helps fund it.

name: Frank Lloyd Wright Houses at the Currier Museum
funding: The Currier Museum of Art runs both houses. The Zimmerman House came with an operating endowment in 1988. An anonymous donor paid for the Kalil House in 2019.

name: American Museum of the Cuban Diaspora
funding: Non-profit Cuban Museum Inc. A $10 million Miami-Dade County bond grant (2004) built it and county funds support it. The City of Miami added $175,000 in American Rescue Plan money.

name: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
funding: Miami-Dade County owns and supports Vizcaya. The Florida Division of Cultural Affairs adds partial funding. Vizcaya announced a $20M gift from Ken Griffin on 7 November 2025.

name: Fallingwater
funding: The Western Pennsylvania Conservancy owns and runs Fallingwater on member gifts and tour and event tickets. Huntington Bank sponsored the Twilight Tour in 2018.

name: Alice Austen House
funding: Friends of Alice Austen House runs it on NYC Cultural Affairs, NYS Council on the Arts, NEA and NEH support, plus the Hillman Family, Auchincloss, Keith Haring and Teiger foundations.

name: Center for Cuban Studies
funding: Non-profit educational institution founded in 1972 that runs the Cuban Art Space gallery. Its 2024 revenue was $296,120, of which $194,216 was contributions and $86,374 program services (Form 990).

name: Modulightor Building (Paul Rudolph Institute)
funding: Founder Ernst Wagner gave the building to the Paul Rudolph Institute in 2023. Open-house tickets ($30), donations, memberships and design store sales fund it.
